jun: I'll review social tiles, we need 3 sizes: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1200x1200. Do we have merchant-approved copy? @alex

```
- White reversed logo (SVG/PNG)
- 3 social tile sizes (1200x628,1080x1080,1200x1200)
- One-pager PDF (press-ready)
- Case study draft (Google Doc link)
- Brand guideline excerpt (logo spacing, min size)

- Final screenshots (1280x720)
```
I can mock the explainer diagram if they can't deliver.
marta: Partner said they'd send logos by EOD tomorrow. Jun — can you prepare the social tile templates and share in #marketing-assets? :thumbsup:
jun: Yep. Will upload to drive under /partnerships/nebulacloud/assets by tomorrow noon. Will also do alt copy variants for A/B testing.
alex: Quick note — need to redact one customer name in the case study until we get explicit permission. I'll DM Nebula legal.
kevin: Also: confirm color hex values. Nebula uses #0B3D91 and #00C2A5. Is that consistent with our palette? Might need contrast tweak.
